description: This file serves as an entry point for the Google Chat channel plugin in the OpenClaw project. It imports core SDK types and functions, re-exports key components, and defines the plugin's registration with its ID, name, description, and associated runtime and plugin implementations.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Defines and registers a new channel plugin with specified configuration including ID, name, description, plugin implementation, and runtime setup.
